requirements.detail: solids 1, shells 1, closed True, valid True, strict False, faces 12

requirements.name: 1 extent
requirements.detail: projected span (Y) 900.000000 mm vs spec 900.000 (diff 7.71e-10); volume 1239793.360 mm3 (cap adds 48685.029; OCCT default integration gives 1239803.757)

requirements.name: 2 locked outline
requirements.detail: max outermost lip deviation 1.54e-09 mm over 202 cut planes; outline-to-surface max 2.39e-08 mm

requirements.name: 3 joins G1
requirements.detail: 4 edges, 1596 samples: gap 3.60e-06 mm, angle 3.62e-05 deg; curvature mismatch 1.034e+01 /mm (cross-join normal curvature 1.034e+01 /mm); closest sample to an edge end 0.00032 mm, 48 samples near collapsed corners not judged

requirements.name: 3 cap seams G1
requirements.detail: 2 edges between curved cap faces: gap 3.47e-17 mm, angle 4.10e-15 deg, curvature mismatch 9.936e-16 /mm

requirements.name: 4 section rule
requirements.detail: 40 cuts (0 failed to trace); thick zone min radius 0.0271259 mm at x/c 0.00100063 (24 of 26 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 0.034 at x/c 0.99752169, t 0.45 mm (14 of 14 below 0.9); 34 of the failing cuts cross the lip more than 60 deg from square; bending reversals 284 on 40 cuts

requirements.name: 4b lip-normal radius (informational)
requirements.detail: radius across the lip, perpendicular to the locked outline, at each cut's lip point; thick zone min 0.4299 mm at x/c 0.979955 (0 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 1.075 at x/c 0.98501363 (0 below 0.9)

requirements.name: 5 whole-cap map
requirements.detail: worst point radius 0.0665137 mm at x/c 1, t 0.4 mm, ratio 0.3326; tightest 0.0665137 mm at x/c 1; points within 0.05 mm of collapsed corners not judged (grid reaches 0.00033 mm; worst there 1.5 mm, score 36)

requirements.name: 6 TE closure
